name: telegram
description: Chat with the assistant from Telegram through a bot you create (free, via @BotFather). Only accounts you pair can use it; anything that changes something asks you with Approve / Deny buttons.

options.name: api_base
options.label: Bot API server
options.help: Leave empty for Telegram's own server (https://api.telegram.org), or point it at a self-hosted Bot API server.

secrets.name: bot_token
secrets.label: bot token
secrets.help: In Telegram, message @BotFather, send /newbot, and paste the token it gives you.
